# GrabHand

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · assembly `VRFramework.Interaction.Runtime` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Runtime/Scripts/Interaction/GrabHand.cs#L15)

One hand of the rig, and the framework's own grabbing logic. Collects the grabbables it touches,
decides every physics step whether the grab conditions of one of them are met, and holds it by
driving its rigidbody to the grab point. Three ways to grab are supported - see
[`GrabType`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GrabType) - each with its own hold and release test.


## Methods

### Grab(GrabbableObject) {#grab-grabbableobject}

Takes hold of an object: applies its custom pose when it has one, records the finger spread that
the hold is later measured against, and takes it off the other hand when it allows swapping.

```csharp
public void Grab(GrabbableObject objectToGrab)
```

### Release() {#release}

Lets go of whatever is held, unlocks the hand pose and blocks grabbing again for a moment, so
the object is not caught straight back by the fingers still closed around it.

```csharp
public void Release()
```
